title: Sort Colors
description: Given an array `nums` with `n` objects colored red, white, or blue, sort them in-place so that objects of the same color are adjacent, with the colors in the order red (0), white (1), and blue (2). Return the sorted array.

hints.content: Maintain three pointers: low, mid, high.
If nums[mid] === 0, swap(low, mid), low++, mid++. If nums[mid] === 1, mid++. If nums[mid] === 2, swap(mid, high), high--.

solution.explanation:
Dutch National Flag 3-pointer partition in a single pass.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
